launcher.notes: Crash-card freshness gate (old crash logs never re-show), real close-after-launch, and a fully detached game process - closing or even Task-Manager-ending the launcher can no longer crash Minecraft. Bundles Client v3.0.0 (the KUI release).

notes: Client v3.2.3 'SafeType': the PojavLauncher startup SIGSEGV is fixed at its REAL root. v3.2.1 and v3.2.2 crashed byte-identically even though the logo upload path changed, which proved the crash was the FIRST custom-font text draw: Font.createFont -> Graphics2D.drawString - the freetype glyph rasterizer of PojavLauncher's OpenJDK (a native memcpy that never throws, so it could never be caught). v3.2.3 detects PojavLauncher-class runtimes and quarantines every AWT-native path: custom fonts are replaced by the proven vanilla FontRenderer, all image ops (skin normalize, cape copies, favicons, rounded icons) are now pure-Java pixel pipelines on every platform, and the AWT font-manager boot is skipped entirely. Desktop is untouched (full TTF fonts). Also now testable: '@' no longer opens Twitch, the non-classic mod menu is a centered Badlion-style window with a full Settings tab, and the SDF smooth-UI renderer is GLES2-safe.
